summary: Fast Track Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq Staff Determination to delist its ordinary shares from the Nasdaq Capital Market for failing to meet the $1.00 minimum bid price rule (Rule 5550(a)(2)). The company failed to regain compliance by the extended deadline of August 10, 2026. Trading will suspend August 18, 2026, with shares expected to trade on OTC Markets under FTRKF. The company intends to appeal to a Hearings Panel, which stays Form 25-NSE filing but not the suspension. An extraordinary general meeting on August 17, 2026, will vote on a share consolidation. Watch the panel decision and potential OTC transition.
